programme.title: My Van Life
programme.desc: A colorful graffiti artist in Austin shares her story of loss with Lisa and gives her a tarot reading. We travel to rural Texas to overnight with Jupiter: an outspoken non-binary person of color living in their vintage RV and studying law.

programme.title: My Van Life
programme.desc: Lisa spontaneously joins a sober dance party on a mountain top in Sedona and meets spiritual Van Lifers who have dramatically changed their entire existence including former NFL player Joe Hawley.

programme.title: My Van Life
programme.desc: Lisa heads to Utah, the ultimate playground for Van Life adrenaline junkies. Base jumper Derrick shows how confronting death helps you appreciate life, while a solo female traveller challenges Lisa to go bouldering.

programme.title: My Van Life
programme.desc: Lisa meets off-grid desert nomads living this way out of necessity, not choice. Van Life rebels rule Slab City, while in Nevada, Van Life godfather Bob Wells helps thousands embrace nomadic life in dire straits.

programme.title: My Van Life
programme.desc: Lisa connects with a nomad poet who literally helps her climb out of her funk by scaling a challenging peak. After taking tea with a magician Lisa meets a paramedic single mother hoping to imbue her daughter with valuable life experiences.

programme.title: My Van Life
programme.desc: Lisa heads to Santa Monica to hang with a Hollywood producer and check out his pimped out Mercedes Benz G-Wagon. Lisa is welcomed into the school bus home of a family of 7! Because there is always room for one more.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: India’s Natural Beauties: Udaipur and Jaipur
programme.desc: Cruise the lake visiting palaces and temples along the shore, tour the majestic City Palace and the Garden of the Maids of Honor. Then explore Jaipur's Pink City, including the Palace of Winds and Amber Fort.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.desc: Join us as we discover the amazing history of this ancient city through its religion, royal lineage, architecture and art. In the markets, Bill shows you how to buy souvenirs like a pro.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: The Wildlife of Rajastan: Ranthambore & Keoladeo National Parks
programme.desc: Ranthambore National Park is part of Project Tiger, a conservation program protecting the magnificent tiger. Spot tigers, sambar, blue bull, wild boar and langur monkeys in this wildlife haven.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.desc: Join us as we cruise the backwaters of Kerala, one of the most beautiful and serene areas of India. We explore the cities of Cochin and Kozhikode. Attend a local theater performance and learn about traditional drama styles.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: The Far North: Amritsar, Shimla and Manali
programme.desc: The Golden Temple is the centerpiece of the city of Amritsar, and probably the second most photographed building in India, but few know about the building or the people who built it.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.desc: Agra is home to India’s most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. We tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal’s construction.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: The Land of Rudyard Kipling: Kanha & Bandhavgarh National Parks
programme.desc: With classic tales as The Jungle Book to his credit, Rudyard Kipling brought India to life for many readers around the world. In this episode, Bill steps back into Kipling’s wild world while exploring Kanha and Bandhavgarh National Parks.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the Gateway to India: Mumbai. From its early history, it’s many foreign occupations to the hustle and bustle of today. Bill tells Mumbai’s rich history is told through two of its inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: Gir - The Last Refuge of the Lion
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: Nepal - Kathmandu and Chitwan National Park
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: Tamil Nadu: Chennai, Pondicherry and Much More
programme.desc: Chennai, formerly known as Madras, can trace its roots back to a tiny fishing village. Bill explores the city’s growth under the British East India Company, with visits to Fort St. George and the Fort Museum.

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: Old and New Delhi…A City of Contrasts
programme.desc: We explore the capital of India. The bustling metropolis is filled with modern skyscrapers that stand side-by-side with hundreds of ancient monuments, making Delhi a physical dichotomy of yesterday and tomorrow.

programme.title: Chuck's World
programme.desc: In Iceland, Chuck eats fermented shark, tours geothermal greenhouses, and bakes rye bread in a geyser before making gravlax cake on a surf beach.

programme.title: Chuck's World
programme.desc: Chuck hits Marseille to fish with locals, grill on seaside cliffs, master world-class pizza, and make goat cheese with an urban farmer.

programme.title: Chuck's World
programme.desc: In Scotland, Chuck hunts pheasant, meets Highland cows, eats classic fish and chips, and learns to make traditional haggis at a legendary butcher.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace explores Edinburgh over 3 days, diving into its history, tasting local classics, and braving a dip in the Firth of Forth.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace explores York’s food and history over 3 days and even adds his own touch to the famous York Minster.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the Italian city of Venice for three days of amazing food, breathtaking sights, and a canal-side view of the city from his own kayak.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the Greek capital, Athens, for 3 days of fantastic food and amazing archeological sites in a city steeped in history. He even gets cast as an actor in a Greek Tragedy!

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the Turkish Capital, Istanbul, for a Weekend Break. Over the course of 3 days he discovers amazing local dishes, uncovers the city's spectacular sights.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the Hungarian capital, Budapest. Over the course of three days, he discovers a fascinating food culture shaped by centuries of invasions, and explores the city.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to Munich to discover how the Bavarian capital has shaped the nation of Germany. Over 3 days he discovers a fascinating food culture - full of pretzels and pork and explores the history of this distractive German state.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to Madeira for winter sun, whale watching, forest hikes, iconic basket rides, and a deep dive into local food and wine.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat the World
programme.desc: Andy and Ben land in Mexico, getting a local lunch, hitting street taco stalls, dining in traditional Puebla, and eating a kilo of meat each in Oaxaca.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat the World
programme.desc: The boys land a massive sailfish in Puerto Escondido, learn to make blue corn tortillas in Chiapas, and cook a VIP meal for the Australian Ambassador.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat the World
programme.desc: In Spain, Andy and Ben explore La Boqueria Market, ride a gourmet food bus, hunt for wild mushrooms, and visit a farmhouse to cure sausages.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat the World
programme.desc: The boys try ancient Basque rock lifting, stomp wine grapes with their feet, taste local delicacies, and learn the fine art of carving jamón.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat the World
programme.desc: After attempting flamenco dancing, the lads cross into Portugal, cooking with top chef José Avillez before catching fresh snapper in the Algarve.

programme.title: Homes by the Sea
programme.desc: Charlie explores Pembrokeshire's coast, touring a famous hillside home, an estuary factory build, and a cottage set inside a castle ruin.

programme.title: Homes by the Sea
programme.desc: Charlie explores Devon's coastline, touring a cliff-side modern house, an estuary cottage, a 1960s-inspired hall, and a home with a gold sail.

programme.title: Homes by the Sea
programme.desc: In Norfolk, Charlie visits an old quayside granary, checks out a restored lighthouse, steps into a converted public toilet, and tours a windmill B&B.

programme.title: Homes by the Sea
programme.desc: Heading to Scotland, Charlie explores Viking-inspired builds, a renovated white house, a modern croft, and an off-grid eco-bothy.

programme.title: Homes by the Sea
programme.desc: Exploring the southern coast, Charlie inspects a modern beachfront retreat, a converted railway carriage, a Martello tower, and Regency homes.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: Piri Weepu heads to Tolaga Bay for crayfish and kina with local Richard Meihana. After a history lesson from a kuia, they pluck freshwater mussels from the riverbed for a whānau gathering.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.sub-title: EELS + DEER HUNTING + BREAKING IN HORSES
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Masterton to try his hand at eeling. Plus two Martinborough locals take Piri deer hunting and show him how to break in a horse.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Herekino where he meets local characters, brothers, Chad and Theo who take him on an epic pig hunting adventure.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri Weeps heads North to Rangiputa. Guided by locals Wikatana and Sandy, the trio hit the water for a kina dive. Plus Piri gains some insight on a rahui established in Ahipara.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri heads to Turangi to go fly fishing on upper reaches of the Tongariro River only accessible by white water rafting.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Wellington with his dive team, the ‘Kina Crew’. The boys hit the west and southern coastlines to collect kai moana ahead of their annual ‘AGM’.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in the Chatham Islands hunting wild ram and weka with one of the locals known as Big Jase.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in the Chatham Islands meeting up with local, Floyd Prendeville, who takes Piri spear fishing for Hapuka and drifting for flounder.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri travels to the West Coast of the South Island to visit his grandparents. His Uncle Tangi and cousin Arama show him how to catch whitebait on the Arahura River.

programme.title: Piri's Tiki Tour
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri goes deep sea fishing in Tokomaru Bay. Plus a father and son duo take Piri deer stalking.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie.
programme.sub-title: Philippines: Why is Filipino food unpopular?
programme.desc: Liesel embarks on a journey to the country of over 7000 islands, the Philippines. From the serene to the seedy, she combs through metro Manila discovering the food; this culinary spectrum includes bouncing around trying the popular fast food joints, meeting the local experts such as blogger Cheryl Tiu, a taste of history at the world's oldest Chinatown, an unexpected dancing session at the Spanish haunts of Manila, to rubbing shoulders with the elite Chefs of the city. All in a quest to answer just why Filipino cuisine is unheard of!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie.
programme.sub-title: Thailand: US Thai Food vs Authentic-Thai, which is the winner?
programme.desc: Americans are accustomed to Thai food but what you get in mainland Thailand is quite different than the local Thai joint in California. Which is better? Liesel embarks on a mission in Bangkok to understand the essence of what true Thai food is all about.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie.
programme.sub-title: India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?
programme.desc: Liesel pinballs around a city known for its gastronomy, the forgotten hub of British East India trading company, Kolkata. From trying out what the bustling city’s vibrant street food scene has to offer, to the lesser known gems, including, venturing into India’s only Chinatown and sampling their delicacies. A tale of walking food tours, hole in the wall joints serving up North Eastern dumplings, messy fish markets, and of course, the pride of Bengal, the Hilsa fish. Is Kolkata up to par with the other major metropolitan cities of India? This episode finds out exactly that!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie.
programme.sub-title: Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?
programme.desc: This investigative mission starts off in the sin city atmosphere of the Vegas strip. After a gluttonous stint at a generic buffet, Liesel is inspired to do a road trip to find iconic gems in the state of Nevada. From ghost towns, to monstrous foodie challenges, to hole in the wall dive bars in the middle of nowhere, this trip has it all. Liesel finds the resurgence of Basque cuisine in Northern Nevada, and learns that Reno can do fine dining as well! A trip to Virginia city also reveals that the Silver State has some haunted bars where patrons from the 1800s are rumored to be still imbibing and spooking locals! It’s a road trip in every sense of the word!

programme.title: The Kindness Diaries
programme.desc: Leon starts a new journey from Alaska to Argentina depending on the generosity of strangers.

programme.title: The Kindness Diaries
programme.desc: Leon crashes and is stranded on the icy Yukon roads. He is invited to a party where one man opens his home to countless refugees.

programme.title: The Kindness Diaries
programme.desc: After breaking down in Montana, Leon stays in a snowy wonderland. In Salt Lake City one woman’s passion to help others inspires his next gift.

programme.title: The Kindness Diaries
programme.desc: Leon has a close shave and plays cowboy in rural Utah. He visits the USA Mexico border and finds help from a humble Mexican family.

programme.title: The Streets
programme.desc: Harlem rapper Shiniqua Rivers, aka Pretty Little Monster, juggles two kids and a day job while chasing her dream. Refusing to conform, she pours her heart into provocative lyrics, backed by her family.

programme.title: A Simple Path
programme.desc: Empowered in Jozi the city of gold South Africa with the kids from Skateistan, leftfield artists and photographers, streetside Kotas, volcano sessions, Slappy screen printing, a backyard ramp and skating through an art gallery.

programme.title: A Simple Path
programme.desc: Gaborone, Botswana is the turf of The Knuckelheads and unlikely skate spots, True-D fashion, traditional feasts, garage beats, inspiring street art and a fashion shoot in an abandoned building.

programme.title: A Simple Path
programme.desc: Amidst the vast desert, we discover handmade leather shoes, the yellow bus on the beach, Kalahari truffles, the power of gemstones, keepers of the desert elephants and a skate ramp in the middle of the dunes.

programme.title: A Simple Path
programme.desc: Uhuru Park is the nucleus for skateboarders in Gaborone. We meet street Keedz turning their lives around a local animator the producer of Sighkick Mag and learn how to make homemade trucks and sign language at Pallet Café.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet
programme.desc: Gord is in Dangriga, Belize to explore the country's unique melting pot of African, Spanish and Caribbean cuisines. Taking to the streets, he tastes the wares of vendor after vendor - Johnnycakes, tamales, garnaches - Belize's heavenly taco. And then at the Dangriga market, our Delinquent Gourmet discovers varieties of fish he's never even heard of!

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet
programme.desc: Rodney is in Porto, Portugal. And although he's not yet a huge fan of Portuguese food, he's here to see if this seaside city can inspire him to change his mind. After watching the fishermen haul in their catch, Rodney cooks up lunch for one of the fishermen and his wife.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet
programme.desc: In Fez, Morocco, not much has changed since the Middle Ages but Rodney is determined to stir things up and find tantalizing new dishes he can bring home.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet
programme.desc: Rodney is in Sardinia, Italy, where he finds culinary inspiration around every corner. High in the Sardinian hills, his hosts prepare their specialty - roasted suckling pig. After sitting down to an outdoor family meal (where even the dog helps himself!), Rodney samples a myrtle-flavored liquor before dancing with his gentlemen hosts.

programme.title: Roads Unknown: India
programme.desc: After a crash leaves Zombie injured, the crew scrambles to stay on schedule for Ridermania. Jess arrives at the festival, participates in events and is met with overwhelming support from fans and fellow riders. The three-day celebration ends with a visit to a famous Goa beach before the crew heads to Ganpatipule.

programme.title: Roads Unknown: India
programme.desc: Jess and her ride crew navigate the stunning but rugged Konkan Coast, switching between bikes and boats while juggling luggage, riders and a lost phone. Gearshifter unexpectedly joins the team as they race toward Mumbai, determined to get Pulak to the city in time to visit his family.

programme.title: Roads Unknown: India
programme.desc: Jess and the team soak in Mumbai's culture, say goodbye to Pulak, then race for trains to Ahmedabad and Jodhpur. They reunite in Jaisalmer, riding the Thar Desert's iconic dunes.

programme.title: Roads Unknown: India
programme.desc: Jess explores Rajasthan's ancient towns and landmarks, continues to Jaipur for cultural treasures, and reunites with Pulak for the final stretch to Delhi. After bike troubles, they arrive in Delhi, reflecting on their unforgettable journey.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel
programme.desc: Alana joins executive chef ‘Primus’ on a visit to the Budapest Central Market while Skye discovers a gem in the Barossa Valley the historic 1856 estate, Kingsford Homestead.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel
programme.desc: Alana takes a bike ride in the beautiful Hungarian countryside while Scotty visits an impeccable pocket of paradise, Coffs Harbor. Skye discovers an incredible retreat called Appellation set amongst the vines in The Barossa Valley.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel
programme.desc: Skye samples the local produce in the Barossa Farmers market while Alana visits an amazing Roman Fortress built into a rock formation dating back 230 million years and Scotty samples some of the local delicacies at Ravensthorpe.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel
programme.desc: Alana’s back in her home town of Mildura while Scotty taps into his creative side in Melbourne and then continues his trip through the Kimberley with stops in Bells Gorge and Mount Hart.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Maldives / Soneva Jani
programme.desc: At Soneva Jani, Sashi experiences ultra-luxury dining—from crab curry to surprise chef’s tables and sunset BBQs in the Maldives’ most iconic resort.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "New York
programme.desc: Rapper Shiniqua, aka Pretty Little Monster, juggles motherhood while trying to avoid the trappings of Instagram fame. Her passion is writing rap lyrics and always tries to keep it real.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S3 - "St. Thomas and St. Croix
programme.desc: Reconnect with paradise in the U.S. Virgin Islands as Denella explores the beautiful islands of St. Thomas & St. Croix.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S3 - "St. John
programme.desc: Denella "Reconnects With Paradise" in the smallest of the U.S. Virgin Islands - St. John. St. John has some of the world's most beautiful beaches.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S3 - "St. Martin
programme.desc: St. Martin, "The Friendly Island" of the French Caribbean, with its blend of warm hospitality and European style.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Fishing Charter
programme.desc: The couple test their skills running a fishing charter. How will two bed & breakfasters in France cope with their biggest challenge? On the Costa Blanca, a family pulls together to try and rescue their Spanish dream.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Pop-Up
programme.desc: The vineyard owners open a pop up restaurant in a stunning location. Two B&B hosts an event in a bid to boost takings. In Spain, a wannabe fishing captain has to learn the ropes.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Observatory
programme.desc: It’s decision time for a couple hoping to run a fishing charter business. How will two B&B cope with some tricky customers? And with their first guests now booked in, will an observatory business France please it’s punters.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Extreme Homes
programme.desc: Australia is an enormous continent and it has profound variations in climate. Johanna and Pete find Australian designers who have responded to the radical climate by producing some very extreme architecture.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Vintage Twist
programme.desc: Johanna and Pete explore a collection of Australian vintage homes that have been masterfully renovated to meet the needs of modern living without destroying the past.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Inventive Architecture
programme.desc: Explore a collection of houses that have one thing in common - the designers have come up with inventive ideas and radical approaches to solving everyday design issues. It's both clever and inspiring with plenty of take home tips for the home renovator.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Chiang Mai - Eze
programme.desc: From Asia to Europe this episode explore the cultures and magnificent architecture in Chiang Mai and Eze in the South of France.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Ice Hotel, Sweden - Bangkok
programme.desc: From the hustle and bustle of Bangkok to the freezing temperatures of the Ice Hotel in Sweden, this episode is all about polar opposites, fire and ice.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "St Tropez - St Lucia
programme.desc: Romantic Caribbean Islands and sleeping fishing villages turned European jet set resorts, this episode travels from St Lucia to St Tropez.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Liesel explores all the hands-on activities such as riding horseback on the beach, riding ATV’s through the muddy swamps, and hiking through the super lush El Yunque rainforest. Luxurious resorts are only a stone's throw away - hopping islands, Liesel gets to experience the ultra modern and chic El Blok located in Vieques. Between stays at all the luxury boutique resorts, a common trend starts to appear, and that is the island’s cuisine.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Hong Kong
programme.desc: Hong Kong is Asia’s world city and this episode is a complete 360 from the melee of tropical island paradises. Hong Kong is famous for it’s skyscraper strewn skyline and in this episode, local girl Lesley Chiang is on a mission to show a different side of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Belize
programme.desc: Luxe Travels showcases beautiful Belize; with hundreds of kilometers of coastline with the Caribbean sea, the 2nd largest barrier reef, and one of the best dive sites in the world, how could you not? In this episode, Dani Kristo is on a mission to showcase the best of Belize.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Coolest Cayman Islands Vacation
programme.desc: Discover paradise across Little Cayman, Cayman Brac, and Grand Cayman with wreck diving, coastal caves, and a pristine seven-mile beach.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Central Europe Road Trip: Switzerland, France, Belgium
programme.sub-title: Central Europe Road Trip: Switzerland, France, Belgium
programme.desc: Ski the Swiss Alps, experience the natural luxury of the Midi-Pyrenees, tour Paris, and sample local flavors in Belgium.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "The Coolest Islands on Earth
programme.desc: Take island hopping to the extreme from the South Pacific and Easter Island to Kangaroo Island, Mackinac Island, and Maui.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - "Big City Home
programme.desc: A young trendy couple wants to start a family in Toronto but they need some help from these top million dollar agents. Jin is a natural daredevil & has always wanted to skydive with her clients.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - "City Dreams
programme.desc: Moving in together can be stressful but fun because you are starting a new life together! Inez’s client is selling their separate properties & looking for a house or condo in the city or beach area that is close to shopping, groceries, schools, etc.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - "Cottage Getaways
programme.desc: Agreeing on a vacation home is made much harder when these top million dollar agents have astounding listings. Mike’s client is looking for a waterfront cottage with lots of land & privacy.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Martinique
programme.desc: Denella travels to the French Caribbean Island of Martinique where she learns how to sail aboard a traditional YOLE boat.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Nassau
programme.desc: Denella travels to Nassau.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Antigua
programme.desc: Denella goes to Stingray City and swims for the first time with Stingrays.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Dordogne
programme.desc: A family rushes to open a bar while awaiting bank approval. New B&B owners in the Dordogne welcome their first guests. A novice fisherman takes on his first trip in Spain.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Cape Verde
programme.desc: An expat fisherman scores a big catch in Cape Verde, while another struggles in Spain. A French B&B receives its first review, and a boutique hotel launches a wedding business.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "Bondi Backyard
programme.desc: Chris visits China and explores a masterpiece of history , is shadowed by giants on Australia’s Great Barrier Reef, takes on a photo challenge in his own Bondi backyard, and joins a safari to a coastal community, well off the grid.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "Natural Magic
programme.desc: Chris takes on one of the world’s most amazing cities, in search of the old and the new, meets an island local that makes everyone smile, and is on the trail of the elusive Aussie platypus.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Mumbai
programme.desc: Mumbai's rag to riches story is experienced in the entire spectrum; Bollywood roles, a stay at Taj Palace, and an indepth tour of Dharavi slums, oh and dont' forget a spot of rat hunting.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Thailand
programme.desc: Muay Thai, river festivals, tourist scams and mahouts! This is a look at Thailand the Road less Traveled way.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 1
programme.desc: Eric Hanson explores epic coastal hiking routes of Gaspésie and the incredible nighttime wilderness adventures in the Eastern Township of Québec.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 2
programme.desc: Eric Hanson backpacks along the spectacular Saguenay Fjord, before setting out on a paddling adventure in Québec’s Laurentian mountains.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Bluff
programme.desc: Piri’s in Motupõhue, Bluff, where he’s targeting local delicacy, Bluff oysters and Blue Cod. Then he jumps on some big machinery with Ex Southland Stag Jason Kawau.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Wellington
programme.desc: Piri’s in his hometown of Wellington where he hosts his own whanau for dive targeting mussels. He has a go at waka ama with ex Hurricane John Schwalger and his whanau and coaches the Wellington Boys High 1st XV.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Phoenix
programme.desc: Yann delves into Phoenix's diverse skateboarding scene, exploring Cowtown Skateboards. Meeting Hendren a sfashion designer, Christians band, Garnak, Triple paint designs, Justin a blacksmith and Douglas Miles Jr the owner of Apache skateboards.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Nevada City
programme.desc: Yann visits GoodTimes Skate Shop. Meets artist Tahiti Pehrson, skates Beeb's Bowl and Grass Valley SkatePark, Bella's skate camp, and discovers George Rocha's recycled skateboard artistry, culminating in celebrating International Go Skateboard Day.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Mosselbay to Pinnacle Point
programme.desc: As Xander travels from Mosselbay to Pinnacle Point, he and his team encounter a beautiful ziplining course, the best golfing in all of South Africa, and an all inclusive spa day.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Ancient forests of Tsitsikamma
programme.desc: Xander takes full advantage of the opportunities given to him by experiencing all that Tsitsikamma has to offer, whether that be bungee jumping, quad biking, or visiting a 60’s diner.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Animals of Oudtshoorn
programme.desc: Xander starts his day by receiving a surprising phone call from Adam before heading to Chandelier Game Lodge to visit Africa’s most exquisite animals.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Houston
programme.desc: Jamie Hancock was raised in Houston’s South Park area, a place notorious for gang violence, but also where hip hop artists created a new sound. Today, a new positive message is being created by people like Jamie through music.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Estonia / Vietnam
programme.desc: In this episode, Josh travels to Tallinn in Estonia with urban explorer Steve Duncan where they explore Patarei Prison. Meanwhile, Cody is in Vietnam with his friend Sherman Mak and travels to Pan Thiet in search of abandoned amusement park Soui Cat.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Germany / Morocco
programme.desc: This time urban explorers Josh and Cody separately visit Germany and Morocco in search of astonishing abandoned locations including Wünsdorf, the forbidden city near Berlin, and an abandoned filmset in the Sahara desert used for Game of Thrones.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Georgia / France
programme.desc: Josh and Cody are separately visiting Georgia and France. Cody, together with rooftopper Harry Gallagher, undertakes a cable car trip known as 'Stalin’s coffin'. Josh is in France searching for abandoned chateaus with globetrotter Lexie Limitless.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "The Mighty Yangtze
programme.desc: Chris cruises China's mighty Yangtze river, explores the spooky tunnels beneath the bustling streets of Sydney, discovers the Aussie travel spot that is almost too good to be true and faces a test to enter heaven.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "Anyone for Cricket?
programme.desc: Chris meets China’s cricket king, muscles up for an English challenge, has a fashion makeover in Vietnam, spends a day on the Great Barrier Reef and meets his mini match in a fellow animal lover and wildlife warrior.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "Vietnam
